algorithm: diffusion U-Net policy (also compared against ACT) co-trained on human wearable-rig demonstrations and teleoperated robot demonstrations via fixed-ratio batch sampling
hand: LEAP Hand / LEAP Hand V2 Advanced
success_criterion: rubric — Task success rate = fraction of trials scored success against the per-task scoring criteria in Appendix VII-A; task-specific pass/fail descriptions only, no distance/angle threshold.
headline_metric: task success rate, robot-only vs. human+robot co-trained (1:2 ratio)
headline_value: In-Domain 64.7%->79.8%; In-the-Wild 28.5%->75.1%; In-the-Wild Extreme 22.0%->62.7% (Sec. V-A); human-only baseline 3.6% in-domain / 7.3% in-the-wild
human_data: own wearable-rig demonstrations (mocap glove + two palm cameras + wrist ArUco tracking); D_H = 9,290 demos across 5 tasks and 93 environments (Spray Bottle 3,000/30 envs, Toy Cleanup 3,000/30 envs, Pour 621/6 envs, Florist 1,545/15 envs, Clothes Folding 1,124/12 envs)
note_gaps: [penetration label withdrawn: the note does not state that the work leaves interpenetration unaddressed; extraction had asserted it]
operator_interface: wearable, calibration-free rig: motion-capture glove + two palm-mounted stereo cameras (pinky-side and thumb-side) + wrist ArUco marker tracking, worn by untrained operators; no VR headset
retargeting_objective: robot hand kinematics optimized to match observed human fingertip positions (fixed hyperparameters, no per-user tuning); a relative (delta) end-effector state-action representation removes the need for a global coordinate frame, and identical palm-camera mounting on human and robot hands makes RGB observations look the same across embodiments
